scope: Proteomic analysis of myocardium from the left ventricle and right ventricle (RV) of patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

Myocardial samples of LV and RV from 10 patients with HFrEF and severe RVD, 10 patients with HFrEF and preserved RV function (noRVD), and 10 control individuals were subjected to quantitative proteomic analysis.
Tissue samples were homogenized and extracted using mild Triton X-100 detergent
Each sample was then individually lysed in buffer containing 1.5% Triton X-100, 140 mM NaCl, 10 mM HEPES, and pH 7.4 at 4°C for 30 minutes.
